en: Fixed `claude remote-control --help` saying `--[no-]chrome` defaults to the machine's `/chrome` setting; spawned sessions keep Claude in Chrome off unless `--chrome` is passed
zh: 修复 `claude remote-control --help` 声称 `--[no-]chrome` 默认使用机器的 `/chrome` 设置；除非传入 `--chrome`，否则生成的 session 会保持 Claude in Chrome 关闭
